The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes, so no escalation under POL-RD-10(3) is available to the driver and the deviation may rest on the trace alone: EV-GPS-02810 has 245 fixes at a 10.0 s sample interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and a max_gap_sec of 0.0, so none of POL-RD-07 limbs (a), (b) or (c) fires.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. EV-TRIP-02810, EV-GPS-02810 and EV-FARE-02810 all carry trip_id TRP-02810 and all describe the same 2026-08-20 evening trip from Northpoint City to Blk 503 Bishan St 11; and limb (b) is met by an excess of 7.2 km / 30.0% measured on a trace that is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c). The burden therefore shifts to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause.

The driver's only explanation on the record is the statement 'AYE closed, I had to divert', which cites no evidence ID and therefore carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Tested against the advisory for this trip and nothing else, as POL-RD-13 requires, it fails: POL-RD-03 limb (a) needs an advisory naming a road or segment that the optimal route traverses and limb (c) needs an actual route that leaves the optimal corridor before the affected segment and rejoins it after the fact, and the computed comparison on EV-GPS-02810 shows zero fixes inside the advisory area and a closest approach of 1699.49 m to it — the vehicle never enters the affected corridor at all.

That leaves 3.60 km of the measured excess unjustified and refundable, and sets the closure-adjusted optimal at 27.6 km with a duration of 36.8 min.

The refund is arithmetic. EV-FARE-02810 records fare_model METERED, surge_multiplier 1.0 read from the fare_breakdown, and quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not run and POL-RD-02 governs. Against the booked optimal: (3.80 + 0.75 x 24.0 + 0.28 x 32.0) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 31.56. Charged_total is 39.40, so the refund is 7.84, rounded up to SGD 7.85 — 19.9% of charged_total, well clear of the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below the 90% full-refund share. That exceeds the SGD 7.50 the rider contested, so the rider is left carrying none of the disputed charge.

The trace's own avoidance of the closure footprint (the derived advisory-area check records 0 fixes inside the advisory geometry) is what routing around a closed segment looks like. That satisfies POL-RD-03 limbs (a), (b) and (c), and by pointing to a specific artifact and a specific clause the driver discharges the burden POL-RD-08 places on him once the rider has shown an excess.

Exoneration under POL-RD-03 is capped, and the cap bites here. The justified excess is the lesser of the measured excess and 130% of the additional distance of the shortest lawful alternative plus 1.0 km of tolerance: min(7.2 km, 1.30 x (26.0 - 24.0) + 1.00) = min(7.2, 3.60) = 3.60 km. The closure-adjusted optimal route is therefore trip_record.optimal_distance_km + justified_excess = 24.0 + 3.60 = 27.60 km, with its duration scaled from the booked 32.0 minutes by 27.60/24.0 to 36.8 minutes. Once the POL-RD-03 adjustment is made, POL-RD-01 tests the excess that REMAINS, measured on the governing trace figure of 31.2 km: 31.2 - 27.60 = 3.60 km, which is 13.0% of the 27.60 km adjusted optimal. POL-RD-01 requires BOTH limbs to pass — more than 20% of the optimal distance AND more than 0.8 km absolute — and the percentage limb fails, so the route deviation is not established at all. The clause is explicit that where either establishment test fails no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip; the CHARGED fare and the nil refund therefore stand as they are, which is the party-relative effect POL-GEN-03 gives NO_ACTION on a rider-filed dispute.

If the judge takes the other view and treats the residual excess as refundable, the quantum is still far below the rider's number. POL-RD-02 directs that where POL-RD-03 excuses part of the excess the recomputation runs against the ADJUSTED optimal route, not the booked one: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 27.60 + 0.28 x 36.8) x the 1.0 surge multiplier recorded on the fare breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = 35.604, so the refund is 39.40 - 35.604 = 3.796, payable 3.80 after rounding up to the nearest SGD 0.05. ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this is a provisional, automated ruling on trip TRP-02810 (Northpoint City to Blk 503 Bishan St 11, 20 Aug 2026). The rider is partly right.

1. A deviation exists. Measured on the governing trace field (EV-GPS-02810, trace_distance_km 31.2 km, 245 fixes, 10 s sampling, 100% coverage, no gaps, max_gap 0.0 s), against the booked optimal of 24.0 km (EV-TRIP-02810), the excess is 7.2 km, or 30.0% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 limbs pass (30.0% > 20% and 7.2 km > 0.8 km), so the deviation is established. The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c), so no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises and the trace alone may carry the measurement.

2. The driver's excuse applies, but only up to its cap. The bare statement 'AYE closed, I had to divert' cites no evidence ID and carries no weight by itself under POL-RD-08. But the advisory it refers to is on file: EV-ADVIS-02810-01 (LTA DataMall; Ayer Rajah Expressway towards Tuas after Clementi Ave 6; HIGH-severity vehicle fire, all lanes closed; 20:39:44-22:15:24), overlapping this trip's 21:09:44-21:50:24 window and recorded as intersecting the booked route. POL-RD-03 is therefore available and excuses part of the excess. The justified excess is min(7.2 km, 1.30 x (26.0 - 24.0) + 1.00) = min(7.2, 3.60) = 3.60 km, so the closure-adjusted optimal is 24.0 + 3.60 = 27.60 km, with duration 32.0 x 27.60/24.0 = 36.8 min.

3. The driver's argument that the 3.60 km left over is too small to refund (13.0% of 27.60 km) is not accepted. POL-RD-01 is satisfied on the measured excess (7.2 km, 30.0%), and POL-RD-03 states in terms that the excess beyond the cap is not exonerated and is refunded under POL-RD-02 computed against the closure-adjusted optimal route - that is exactly this residue. POL-RD-01's 'excess remaining' rule governs the materiality tier (POL-RD-06), which 3.60 km does not reach. Reading POL-RD-01 to re-test establishment on the adjusted optimal would defeat POL-RD-03's express refund in the very cases its cap exists to police.

4. Refund. The fare is METERED (EV-FARE-02810) and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not run and POL-RD-02 governs; surge_multiplier 1.0 is read from the fare breakdown. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 27.60 + 0.28 x 36.8) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP + 0.00 surcharge + 0.00 waiting - 0.00 promo = 35.604. Charged_total = 39.40. Refund = 39.40 - 35.604 = 3.796, rounded up to SGD 3.80. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and only 9.6% of the fare, so this is a partial refund, not a full one. The rider's higher figure of 7.85 (recomputation against the booked 24.0 km optimal) is not available: the closure-excused stretch comes out before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied.

5. Nothing is added on top, and nothing else excuses the trip. EV-FARE-02810 carries no ERP gantry lines and no airport surcharge (0.00), so there is no separate POL-RD-09 pass-through or billing-integrity correction and no risk of double-counting. There is no rider-requested detour to exclude: EV-CHAT-02810 holds 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 cannot be run. There is no amended endpoint (POL-RD-05 not runnable), and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The deviation is not material and the driver has no trailing-window pattern (deviation_flags_90d 0 of 196 completed trips), so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. The rider's claim needs no extra corroboration (deviation_claims_60d 1, below the POL-RD-08 trigger).

6. Confidence 0.85: the trace, trip record, fare breakdown and advisory all carry weight_multiplier 1.0, so the cap is 1.0. The monetary effect (SGD 3.80) does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue. Either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04.

To both parties: the closure is genuine and excused part of the drive, but only part, so a partial refund of SGD 3.80 is due to the rider.

Undisputed: the GPS trace EV-GPS-02810 measures 31.2 km over 245 fixes at 100% coverage and a 10 s interval, with no gap and max_gap_sec 0.0, so it is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c) and governs over the trip record's rounded copy under POL-RD-01. The booked optimal (EV-TRIP-02810) is 24.0 km / 32.0 min, the measured excess is 7.2 km (30.0%), and the fare (EV-FARE-02810) is METERED with surge_multiplier 1.0 read from the fare breakdown and charged_total SGD 39.40.

The closure applies. EV-ADVIS-02810-01 is a HIGH-severity, all-lanes-closed vehicle fire on the Ayer Rajah Expressway, active 20:39:44-22:15:24, overlapping this trip's 21:09:44-21:50:24 window by 70.7 minutes; the record marks it as intersecting the route, and its footprint sits on the pickup-to-dropoff corridor. The trace stays out of that footprint (0 fixes inside, closest approach 1,699 m), which is what a route taken around a closed segment looks like, so limb (c) is met. The rider's argument that the excuse fails because the vehicle never entered the affected area is therefore rejected, and POL-RD-13 does not apply because a covering advisory is on file.

Exoneration is capped. Justified excess = min(7.2, 1.30 x (26.0 - 24.0) + 1.00) = min(7.2, 3.60) = 3.60 km, giving a closure-adjusted optimal of 24.0 + 3.60 = 27.60 km and a duration of 32.0 x 27.60/24.0 = 36.8 min. The remaining 31.2 - 27.60 = 3.60 km is not exonerated and, on POL-RD-03's own remedy, is refunded under POL-RD-02 computed against the closure-adjusted route.

Refund (POL-RD-02): recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 27.60 + 0.28 x 36.8) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 35.604; refund = 39.40 - 35.604 = 3.796, rounded up to SGD 3.80. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below 90% of charged_total, so neither NO_ACTION nor FULL_REFUND follows.

Two positions are rejected. The rider's unadjusted SGD 7.85 (recomputed_fare 31.56 against the booked optimal) ignores POL-RD-03. The driver's NO_ACTION argument re-runs POL-RD-01's establishment test on the residual; but the deviation was established on the measured 7.2 km / 30.0% excess, and POL-RD-03 expressly provides that excess beyond the cap is refunded under POL-RD-02 against the closure-adjusted optimal, as POL-RD-02's own partial-excuse instruction confirms.

No other adjustment: no rider-requested detour (EV-CHAT-02810 has 0 messages, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test cannot run and no distance is excluded); no amended endpoint (POL-RD-05 unavailable, both amendment fields null); not a pooled trip (vehicle_type RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12 does not apply); and no ERP, toll or surcharge line to add or correct (POL-RD-09 - erp_lines and erp_gantries empty, airport_surcharge 0.0), so nothing is double-counted on top of the distance refund. The driver's profile shows no repeat-deviation pattern (deviation_flags_90d 0 against 196 completed trips in 90 days), so no POL-RD-06 uplift and no conduct referral arises; the rider's profile is below the extra-corroboration threshold (deviation_claims_60d 1).

Every artifact the ruling rests on carries weight_multiplier 1.0, so no discount applies and confidence is not capped; the monetary effect of SGD 3.80 does not exceed the automatic-execution threshold.
